<section_guide number="3" title="What to Demo" references="1,2">
<purpose>Turn the approved minimum PoC and ideal use cases into the shortest intent-revealing demo.</purpose>

<questions>
1. What product intent must the demo make visible, and what is the shortest action sequence that demonstrates it?
2. What must a reviewer observe to call the demo successful?
</questions>

<workflow>
Read Sections 1 and 2. Keep the same Primary Persona, PoC scope, and use case intents.

Compose one connected demo from the persona's sequential actions. The flow may contain one block per
core ideal use case, but it must remain the shortest coherent demonstration. Do not substitute a
feature list or screen tour.

State observable success evidence. Ask for feedback questions only when the PoC can directly answer
them; they are optional.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm the demo intent, flow, and success evidence before saving. Feedback Questions may remain empty.</completion>
</section_guide>
